reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: The masks have a good size and have a well amount of toner, they're very moisturizing and gentle, leaves my skin radiant. The presentation is very convenient l but the container could totally improve because i needed to put something over it to keep it closed 🥺💋
reviews.zh: 面膜size剛剛好，toner份量足，保濕又溫和，用完之後皮膚有光澤。包裝設計好方便，但容器真係要改善，因為我要喺上面加嘢先封得實 🥺💋

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: Haven’t tried it yet. But many reviews and influencers said it is good for the beginners that have never tried the retinol before. Will come to edit after I use. I hope it will not irritate or break out my skin.
reviews.zh: 仲未試過。但好多評價同網紅都話，呢款好啱未試過retinol嘅新手用。試完之後再返嚟編輯。希望用完唔會刺激或者爆瘡。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: I bought this for my sister and I would say her skin looks great! It won’t reverse lines on the face but it makes the skin plump and moist looking. Her skin looks prettier under makeup. Her pores look fantastic too. Literally invisible. These are nice masks.
reviews.zh: 我買咗畀阿妹用，佢塊面望落真係好正！雖然唔可以反轉面上嘅紋路，但令到皮膚望落飽滿有水潤感。化咗妝之後皮膚望落更加靚。毛孔都睇起嚟好好，真係睇唔到。呢啲mask幾好。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: The sheet masks are made from a soft, flexible material that adheres well to the contours of the face, ensuring full coverage. The mask is soaked in a generous amount of essence, which is slightly thick but not too sticky. It stays in place comfortably during use, making it suitable for multitasking while the mask is on.
reviews.zh: 面膜由柔軟有彈性嘅物料製成，可以貼住面部輪廓，確保全面覆蓋。面膜浸住大量精華，質地稍微厚但唔會太黏笠。敷住期間都穩穩定定貼住塊面，可以一邊敷一邊做其他嘢。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: Was pretty scared of this considering it has retinol, be it just a little, but it didn’t cause me to purge and really softened my skin! I’m slowly transitioning into it so I don’t use it daily exactly since I do have relatively sensitive skin!
reviews.zh: 因為入面有retinol，雖然只係少量，本來都幾驚。用完之後冇令我爆瘡，而且真係軟化咗皮膚！因為我屬於敏感肌，所以我慢慢咁適應，唔會日日用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: I’m obsessed with this face mask! After just one use, my skin felt super smooth and looked more even. It was easy to apply, and my face felt soft and refreshed. Definitely adding this to my daily routine—love it!♥️♥️
reviews.zh: 我已經迷上咗呢塊mask！只用咗一次，皮膚已經覺得好滑，膚色望落均勻咗。容易敷上面，敷完之後軟軟哋又refresh。一定加入我嘅日常護膚程序——超愛！♥️♥️

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: This is a great mask for the morning, I've already repurchased. It's really hydrating and makes my makeup apply so nicely afterwards. Has helped minimise the appearance of fine lines i had due to dehydrated skin and i really like the low-waste packaging, a lot more eco friendly (you can't recycle the foil packs here). They have a good size and shape too.
reviews.zh: 呢款係一款好正嘅早上用mask，我已經回購咗。保濕力強，用完之後化妝好貼。因為皮膚缺水而形成嘅細紋望落都有改善，包裝都好低廢量，環保好多（呢度嘅鋁箔包裝係回收唔到嘅）。size同形狀都剛剛好。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Daily Mask Sheet 30ea
reviews.text: The masks are ok. The packaging is terrible. The lid cannot attached to the container at all. I simply put it on top. Try to finished it as soon as possible.
reviews.zh: 面膜本身OK，但包裝真係差。蓋完全扣唔實個容器，我淨係擺咗上去。盡快用完佢。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
